Senses.Explanation: This legal-comic image depicts a person seizing his own topknot and hauling himself to the magistrate: turning oneself in without needing an arresting officer. Youke Xuan applies it to the actor whose declaration he has just quoted and adds a sentence of punishment. Mingzhao Deqian asks the unnamed questioner why he has seized his own topknot and reported to the magistrate after that questioner claims that everyone has lost life and body. Gaofeng Yuanmiao inserts the image into the Liu Tiemo and Guishan case. Shixi Xinyue pairs it directly with carrying the stolen goods and confessing voluntarily, then appraises the answering and modulation in the Baofu and Changqing house. The legal action remains the same across verdict, question, raised case, and comment.
